blocks.text: TUGUEGARAO CITY – Rains induced by the shearline overnight have left floods at the Maluno overflow bridge at Benito Soliven town in Isabela while other bridges and roads have remained submerged in floodwaters in Cagayan on Tuesday (November 24), according to collated reports from disaster response offices here.
